items.title: MIT startup says it can turn diesel trucks into cheaper hydrogen haulers; see it at Disrupt
items.summary: Diesel is expensive and polluting, and LNK Energies says it has come up with a way to replace it with hydrogen, all while undercutting diesel on cost.
items.creator: Tim De Chant

items.title: Google Play now supports private, vibe-coded apps built just for you
items.summary: Google is making it easier to build and use personal Android apps created with AI, without having to make them available to everyone on the Play Store.
items.creator: Sarah Perez

items.title: Satlyt, founded by a former Google and SpaceX product manager, raises $8M to run AI on satellites
items.summary: Satlyt wants to be the Android of orbital computing, offering open software that works on many companies' satellites, versus SpaceX's closed, all-in-one iPhone-style approach.
items.creator: Tim Fernholz
